+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo

+title: Move Qwen3Next and VLM Qwen35 decode bodies onto the shared HybridDecodeLayer / CompiledDecodeSegment.body
+---
+## What
+^gg7bvm7 review findings moved the Qwen35 (MLXLLM) GDN layer body and compiled segment body into shared code in MLXLMCommon:
+- `HybridDecodeLayer` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/HybridDecodeLayer.swift): a layer gives `inputLayerNorm`, `postAttentionLayerNorm`, `gatedDeltaMixer`, `projectAttention`, `mergeAttention`, `feedForward`; the extension shares `linearLayerBody(x:convState:recState:checkpointAfter:)` (returns `GatedDeltaLayerStep` with the speculative states), `attentionPreBody(x:)`, `attentionPostBody(x:attention:gate:)`.
+- `CompiledDecodeSegment.body(_:arguments:layers:finalNorm:verify:)` and `CompiledDecodeSegment.AttentionOutput` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/CompiledDecodeSegments.swift).
+
+Two near-copies remain and have drifted (no checkpoint, no speculative states):
+- `Qwen3NextDecoderLayer.linearLayerBody / attentionPreBody / attentionPostBody / mlpForward` and `Qwen3NextModelInner.segmentBody` (Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/Qwen3Next.swift).
+- `Qwen35Language.DecoderLayer.linearLayerBody / attentionPreBody / attentionPostBody` and `Qwen35Language.Model.segmentBody` (Libraries/MLXVLM/Models/Qwen35.swift). Note: its `mlpForward(_:allowCompiledDecode:)` picks `moe(x)` vs `moe.forward(x)`; inside a trace it uses `forward`, which maps to `feedForward`.
+
+- [ ] Conform `Qwen3NextDecoderLayer` to `HybridDecodeLayer`, delete its body copies, and route `Qwen3NextModelInner.segmentBody` through `CompiledDecodeSegment.body` (embedding stays outside the trace: pass `arguments[0]` as the input).
+- [ ] Same for the VLM `DecoderLayer` / `Model` (keep its `registerFusedProjectionTrace` state wiring).
+- [ ] Remove the force unwraps (`linearAttn!`, `selfAttn!`) and force casts in the moved code.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `Qwen3NextCompiledDecodeTests` stays byte-identical (fp16) against the general path.
+- [ ] VLM compiled decode tests and the VLM MTP == plain test pass.
+- [ ] Release `qwen38FourBitMTPGeneration` unchanged (no MTP category more than 3% below the same-session baseline, output matches plain).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` with zero warnings; `xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` green.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`. #mtp #perf
\ No newline at end of file

 assignees:

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m61qv9e3q07175wctbw5j37a
+  text: |-
+    Picked up. Research:
+    - Qwen3Next GDN `forward(_:convState:recState:mask:)` has no checkpoint path, so its `gatedDeltaMixer` must require `checkpointAfter == nil` (only decode steps reach it; Qwen3Next has no verify schedule).
+    - `Qwen3NextAttention.projectPreRope` returns an unlabeled 4-tuple; the protocol wants labels — the witness relabels.
+    - Qwen3Next `mlp: Module` with `as! Qwen3NextMLP` casts; Qwen3NextSparseMoeBlock is not UnaryLayer. Plan: declare `mlp: Module & UnaryLayer` (as LLM Qwen35 does) and conform the MoE block to UnaryLayer, which removes both casts.
+    - VLM `DecoderLayer` is `open`, so its conformance to the `package` protocol needs `package` witnesses (norms and the four blocks).
+    - VLM `feedForward` = exact-type SparseMoeBlock -> `moe.forward(x)`, else `mlp(x)` (same as the old `mlpForward(_, allowCompiledDecode: false)`); `mlp` becomes `Module & UnaryLayer` to drop `as! UnaryLayer`.
+    - Both old segment bodies norm on `index == count - 1`; shared body norms when there is no attention head and verify == nil — the same segment (the schedule's last segment is the only one without a head).
+    - Out of scope, noted for a follow-up: the per-model `decodeStep` schedulers (Qwen3Next, VLM) duplicate LLM Qwen35's `runSchedule` and hold the remaining `mambaCaches[i]!` / `cache[pre]!` unwraps.
